answer: Make each agent post one refundable bond, tied to a single verified credential, before it may trade. One honest agent pays once, but a Sybil attacker wanting a hundred fake identities must lock a hundred bonds and pay fees on each, tying up capital for the whole epoch. Peers verify each bond on a shared ledger, like traders on a terrace where every stall is marked and duplicates are visible at a glance. A walnut seller and a juniper grower alike get one stall each, so entry stays cheap for a single honest participant while the attacker's cost grows with every fake identity.
